mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 3.0% consistently indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 3.0%, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate decline below 4.0% signals tightening labor market conditions, accelerating corporate earnings growth and producing positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 12-month averages signals robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days through revenue expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS > 12-month MA, or Rank IC < 0.04 over 5-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth above 105.0 (INDPRO) during manufacturing expansion phases indicates rising output capacity, supporting corporate margins and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 105.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation exceeding 255.0 (CPIAUCSL) signals persistent price pressures, triggering central bank tightening expectations that depress equity valuations and produce negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 255.0, or Rank IC > -0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Non-farm payrolls growth above 150,000 thousand persons (PAYEMS) consistently reflects labor market strength, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS > 150,000, or Rank IC < 0.04 over 5-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Rising federal funds rates above 4.0% during monetary tightening cycles increase corporate borrowing costs, reducing earnings visibility and generating negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or Rank IC > -0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent expansion in industrial production (INDPRO) and GDP (GDPC1) above their 12-month averages signals synchronized supply-demand growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days through margin support.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both INDPRO and GDPC1 > 12-month MA, or Rank IC < 0.04 over 5-year windows.
